title: Digital Account Manager
description:
Digital Account Manager - Paid Search & Paid Social

Watford Hybrid

We're looking for a Digital Account Manager with strong experience across Paid Search and Paid Social to join a growing digital agency in Watford.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the combination of client management, digital strategy and hands-on campaign performance. You'll take ownership of a portfolio of clients, becoming their trusted digital partner while ensuring campaigns are delivering against their commercial objectives.

The role

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing a portfolio of client accounts and building strong, long-term relationships
- Planning and delivering integrated Paid Search and Paid Social strategies
- Managing campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta and LinkedIn
- Taking ownership of campaign budgets, performance and optimisation
- Translating client objectives into clear digital strategies and media plans
- Monitoring performance against KPIs including CPA, ROAS, CPL, conversions and revenue
- Identifying opportunities to improve performance and grow client accounts
- Producing reports and presenting results and recommendations to clients
- Running regular client calls, meetings and performance reviews
- Coordinating campaign activity with internal creative, content and wider digital teams
- Supporting campaign testing across audiences, creative, messaging and landing pages
- Keeping clients informed on platform developments and new opportunities

About you

You'll ideally have:
- 3+ years' digital marketing / paid media experience
- Previous agency experience
- Strong knowledge of Paid Search and Paid Social
- Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager
- Experience with Microsoft Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager would be beneficial
- Strong understanding of GA4, conversion tracking and campaign reporting
- Experience managing multiple clients and campaigns simultaneously
- Confidence presenting campaign results and recommendations to clients
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into actionable insights
- Excellent communication and relationship-management skills
- A commercial mindset with an understanding of how digital activity contributes to wider business objectives

You don't need to be the deepest technical specialist in every platform, but you should understand paid media well enough to challenge performance, spot opportunities and confidently advise clients.

What's on offer
- Hybrid working in Watford
- Varied portfolio of client accounts
- Ownership of both client relationships and digital strategy
- Exposure across Paid Search and Paid Social
- Supportive agency environment
- Clear progression towards Senior Account Manager / Account Director

This would suit a Digital Account Manager, Paid Media Account Manager or Senior Paid Media Executive looking to take greater ownership of client relationships while remaining close to campaign strategy and performance.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Part time (3 days per week)

My client is looking for a proactive and enthusiastic Marketing Executive to take ownership of the marketing function within their growing business. This is a standalone role, offering complete autonomy and flexibility for someone who enjoys working independently, bringing ideas to the table and seeing them through from concept to completion.

Day-to-Day of the Role:
- Take ownership of all marketing activity across the business, from planning through to execution.
- Develop and implement cost-effective marketing initiatives that support business growth and brand awareness.
- Create engaging content for a variety of channels, including website, e-mail campaigns, brochures, and social media.

- Manage customer communications and marketing campaigns using CRM and e-mail marketing platforms.
- Ensure all marketing activity is carried out with discretion and professionalism, reflecting the nature of the company's client base.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

The business works with a number of private and government-related clients, meaning discretion and professionalism are important.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas will be heard, your development will be supported, and you'll have the freedom to make a real impact, please apply today!

title: Senior Communications Officer
company: Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council - Agency - Permanent
description:
Starting salary £41,992pa with progression to £45,089 through annual increments subject to satisfactory service (inclusive of outer fringe allowance)

37 hours per week (hybrid working - 3 days per week in the office)

We have a fantastic and rarely available opportunity to work in our high performing Communications, Marketing and Engagement team. As Senior Communications Officer, you will be leading our team of dedicated Communications Officers working across PR, marketing, and digital communication.

No day will be the same and the post holder will be required to be flexible and think creatively to bring a fresh approach, from developing communication plans with service teams to protecting our reputation in emergency and crisis situations.

You will have exceptional communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across the council and advise our senior management team and elected Members. Developing excellent working relationships with local media and other stakeholders will be key to maximise opportunities to raise the council's profile.

With an eye for detail and excellent proof-reading skills, you will support the production of our highly popular borough magazine, weekly staff newsletter and other literature. Our brand is important to us, and you will support us to visualise and embed our new values, priorities, and vision.

We are looking for a candidate who can be flexible, manage conflicting priorities and work well under pressure when needed. In return, you will be supported to develop and thrive in this role, whilst taking opportunity of the many benefits we have to offer.

The post is hybrid with the expectation of attending the office three days a week, dependent on service needs. You will be required to attend more often during your training.

You will have the flexibility to attend occasional evening meetings and weekend events.

The post holder will have a full UK driving licence to be able to travel across the borough.

You will be working in the heart of Welwyn Garden City in our vibrant office. We offer flexible working to achieve a good work life balance, generous annual leave, discount to the council owned leisure facilities and much more.

We offer the Local Government Pension Scheme, which is a defined benefits scheme.

Our CORE values-Collaborative, Open, Responsible, Excellent-guide everything we do.

We are changing:

Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council (WHBC) is undergoing Local Government Reorganisation (LGR). If you are employed by WHBC on 1 April 2028, it is expected that the majority of roles will transfer to the newly-created unitary councils on existing terms and conditions under TUPE (Transfer of Undertakings - Protection of Employment) principles.

LGR is one of the biggest changes in local government we will face in a generation. It will reshape how we work and how services are organised and gives us a real opportunity to build something better.

Please note that we do not provide sponsorship for employment in the UK.

We suggest that you download the role profile as this will not be available once the vacancy closes.

Closing date for applications: 13 September 2026.

Remote assessments will be held on 17 September 2026.

Face to face interviews will be held on 21 and 24 September 2026.

title: Senior SEO Executive / SEO Specialist - Agency Experience
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an SEO Specialist to join a creative agency that helps small and medium-sized businesses strengthen their online presence through innovative website design, branding, and digital marketing solutions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing tailored SEO strategies designed to improve search visibility, increase organic traffic, and drive long-term success across multiple client websites.

This office-based position offers a salary of £30,000 - £45,000 DOE, alongside a range of attractive benefits. They are ideally seeking local candidates.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, implement, and manage effective SEO campaigns across a variety of client accounts.
- Conduct comprehensive website audits to identify opportunities for optimisation and growth.
- Perform keyword research and implement on-page SEO improvements.
- Optimise website architecture, URL structures, metadata, and technical elements to enhance search performance.
- Create and refine engaging, SEO-focused content while supporting link-building initiatives.
- Monitor campaign performance using analytics tools and provide clear, insightful monthly, quarterly, and annual reports.
- Manage and enhance local SEO activity, including business listings and citations.
- Build strong relationships with clients, providing regular updates and demonstrating campaign success.
- Coordinate with internal teams and external suppliers, including copywriters, to deliver projects effectively.
- Support paid search initiatives where required.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience as an SEO Specialist, SEO Analyst, SEO Consultant, SEO Executive, SEO Manager, SEO Strategist, SEO Account Manager, or in a similar SEO-focused role.
- Ideally, 5-10 years' experience within agency environment.
- Proven experience managing SEO campaigns across multiple client accounts.
- Strong knowledge of organic search principles, including keyword research, metadata optimisation, and content strategy.
- Solid understanding of technical SEO and website architecture.
- Highly skilled in HTML and CSS.
- Hands-on experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
- Demonstrated ability to develop content strategies and execute effective link-building campaigns.
- Up-to-date knowledge of search engine algorithms, emerging industry trends, and the evolving impact of AI within search.
- Excellent written English skills with the ability to produce compelling, audience-focused content.
- Experience with Google Ads and PPC would be advantageous.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary
- Occasional performance-related bonuses.
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing by one additional day per year of service up to 25 days.
- Hybrid working arrangements available following successful completion of probation.
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
- The opportunity to join a collaborative, forward-thinking agency where your ideas and expertise will make a genuine impact.

If you're passionate about SEO, thrive in a fast-paced agency environment, and are looking to take the next step in your career with a business that values innovation and results, we'd love to hear from you.
